description: Calculus + analysis decomposed. ODE existence-uniqueness, PDE classification (elliptic/parabolic/hyperbolic), Sobolev spaces, distributions, Fourier theory, Laplace transform, calculus of variations, Lagrangian + Hamiltonian mechanics, gauge theory math.

sub_mechanisms.name: Picard_existence_uniqueness
sub_mechanisms.definition: Lipschitz continuity of f guarantees unique solution to y' = f(t,y).
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Determines whether ODE well-posed. Standard theorem.

sub_mechanisms.name: PDE_classification
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Different behaviour: elliptic equilibrium, parabolic diffusion, hyperbolic propagation.

sub_mechanisms.name: Sobolev_spaces
sub_mechanisms.definition: W^{k,p}: functions with k weak derivatives in L^p. Generalize smoothness.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of modern PDE theory. Weak solutions. Hilbert space H^k = W^{k,2}.

sub_mechanisms.name: distributions_Schwartz
sub_mechanisms.definition: Generalised functions. Linear functionals on test functions. Dirac delta.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Handles non-smooth functions rigorously. Foundation of distribution theory.

sub_mechanisms.name: Fourier_series_convergence
sub_mechanisms.definition: Periodic L² function = Σ c_n e^{inx}. Converges in L² (Riesz-Fischer).
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Convergence: L² always; pointwise (Carleson). Foundation harmonic analysis.

sub_mechanisms.name: Fourier_transform_math
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Already in engineering signals; here mathematical theory. Quantum mechanics.

sub_mechanisms.name: calculus_of_variations
sub_mechanisms.definition: Minimise functional ∫L(y, y', x) dx. Euler-Lagrange equation: ∂L/∂y - d/dx(∂L/∂y') = 0.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Brachistochrone, geodesics. Foundation of mechanics, optimal control.

sub_mechanisms.name: Lagrangian_mechanics
sub_mechanisms.definition: L = T - V. Path minimising ∫L dt = physical trajectory.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation classical mechanics. Generalises Newton. Foundation of QFT.

sub_mechanisms.name: Hamiltonian_mechanics
sub_mechanisms.definition: H = T + V. Equations: q̇ = ∂H/∂p, ṗ = -∂H/∂q. Phase space.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Conservation laws via Noether. Bridge to QM (Schrödinger ↔ Heisenberg).

sub_mechanisms.name: Noether_theorem
sub_mechanisms.definition: Continuous symmetry of action → conservation law. Time translation → energy.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation modern physics. Connects symmetry to conservation. Universal.

sub_mechanisms.name: Stokes_theorem_general
sub_mechanisms.definition: ∫_M dω = ∫_{∂M} ω. Generalises FTC + Green + Stokes + divergence.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Differential forms. Unifies vector calculus theorems. Universal.

sub_mechanisms.name: spectral_theorem_operators
sub_mechanisms.definition: Self-adjoint compact operator on Hilbert space: complete orthonormal eigenbasis.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation QM. Generalises finite-dim spectral theorem. Foundation functional analysis.

derivation_rules.name: Lipschitz_guarantees_unique_solution
derivation_rules.why: Picard-Lindelöf theorem. Foundation. Many physical systems Lipschitz, hence deterministic.

derivation_rules.name: PDE_type_determines_method
if: PDE classified as elliptic, parabolic, or hyperbolic
derivation_rules.why: Elliptic: BVP, FEM, multigrid. Parabolic: IVP + BVP, Crank-Nicolson. Hyperbolic: characteristic, MUSCL. Foundation.

derivation_rules.name: Fourier_diagonalizes_translation_invariant
derivation_rules.why: Foundation. Linear PDEs with constant coefficients soluble via Fourier. Foundation of signal processing.

derivation_rules.name: Euler_Lagrange_for_extremals
derivation_rules.why: Foundation of calculus of variations. Geodesics, mechanics, optimal control. Universal.

derivation_rules.name: Noether_symmetry_conservation
derivation_rules.why: Time-translation → energy. Space → momentum. Rotation → angular momentum. Foundation modern physics.
